races.paceDynamic: Smoke Trail, Nobotheratall and Thorneylands will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to jostle for the early lead. This genuine pace will stretch the field and test stamina over the 2m2f trip, particularly as these pace-setters have the ability to sustain their effort. The relentless gallop will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver their challenges late. This pace scenario strongly favours the patient, hold-up performers who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and tie up in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The sustained battle between Smoke Trail, Nobotheratall and Thorneylands will drain their reserves, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past with fresh legs. Herja and Bogha Baiste are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Survivor
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner breaks clear from the early battle and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: Either Smoke Trail's class or Nobotheratall's recent good going form allows them to establish a winning lead while their pace rivals fade. The winner sustains their effort better than expected over this stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters cancel each other out but don't completely collapse
scenarios.body: The prominent runners like Changemyluck and Hashtag Queen can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early speed battle. They inherit the perfect position as the leaders weaken but before the hold-up horses can reach them.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Thorneylands Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Thorneylands shows improved stamina and handles the pace better than expected
scenarios.body: The lesser-fancied front-runner gets a soft lead when his more fancied pace rivals over-race early. His 29-day break gives him the freshness to see out the trip when others tire.

watchPoints.text: Smoke Trail could lead throughout if the other pace-setters don't engage early enough
Watch for Herja to be held up too long by inexperienced 7lb claimer Harry Sexton
Changemyluck's jumping will be crucial if tracking the strong early pace
The three front-runners could string out the field completely if they all commit early
Bogha Baiste needs to overcome recent inconsistency to capitalize on ideal race shape

races.paceDynamic: Kilmore Rock will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge, creating a sustainable galloping tempo throughout the 2m6½f trip. The prominent runners Menaggio, Jehol De Thaix, Secret Secret, Dollar Collar, and Magic Wave will track within 3-4 lengths, while the hold-up horses Heart Above, Jericoacoara, Starlyte, Nosy Neighbour, and Rauzan settle towards the rear. With Kilmore Rock unchallenged early, the pace will be even but not slow, setting up a fair test where prominent runners can track the leader comfortably and still have enough left to mount their challenge. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can stay close to the pace without being caught in early speed battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock maintains a steady gallop and the prominent trackers get first run
scenarios.body: The even pace allows Menaggio, Jehol De Thaix, and Magic Wave to stay close without working hard, then strike decisively from the last hurdle. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground against well-positioned pace-trackers who haven't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock's sustainable pace proves too much for the field to peg back
scenarios.body: Having not been pressured early, Kilmore Rock maintains his galloping rhythm and proves hard to pass despite his moderate rating. The prominent runners find his even tempo has taken more out of them than expected over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the back-markers to close significantly, with Heart Above and Jericoacoara timing their runs perfectly. Their superior class ratings tell in a bunched finish where tactical positioning matters less.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously turning in
scenarios.body: The sedate tempo creates a cavalry charge from the last, with horses from all positions having chances. The race becomes a messy scramble where stamina and jump accuracy under pressure decide the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Kilmore Rock's jumping under pressure - if challenged turning in, his hurdle technique may deteriorate and open door for prominent trackers
Secret Secret's fitness after 157-day absence - early signs of her stamina lasting will determine if long break has left her vulnerable
Jehol De Thaix's position tracking the leader - if he gets close enough to Kilmore Rock he has the form and class to strike
Heart Above's early positioning - if he's too far back early the tactical pace may not allow his superior rating to tell
Dollar Collar's jumping confidence after recent fall - any hesitation at hurdles will cost him vital lengths in tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Old Gregorian will lead with Jet Legs and Breizh River tracking prominently in the early stages, creating a sustainable gallop rather than a breakneck pace. With five hold-up horses including Special Rate, Garde Des Champs, and Joecooker positioned further back, the race will develop into a tactical affair where the early leaders can dictate terms. The moderate pace will allow prominent racers to stay in touch without overexerting, while the hold-up brigade may find themselves with too much ground to make up over this staying trip. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Old Gregorian and the early leaders maintain a steady gallop without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows Jet Legs and Breizh River to travel comfortably in behind before making their moves turning for home. Hold-up horses struggle to close the gap as the prominent runners have saved energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses into a crawl and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: Special Rate or Garde Des Champs gets the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kick from the back of the field. The tactical nature allows closers to position perfectly and benefit from a sprint finish over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Goes Gate-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Old Gregorian kicks clear approaching the second-last fence and sustains his effort
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old's dual course-winning experience over hurdles translates to the larger obstacles as he builds an unassailable lead. His proven stamina over this course and distance allows him to resist late challenges from closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants the lead and they crawl through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the last fence where stamina counts for nothing and tactical positioning is everything. Kay Tara Tara's light weight and Looking Splendid's recent course form become decisive factors in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Cadell will lead uncontested from the front, setting his own tempo with Red Happy and Walk On Quest tracking within striking distance but not applying early pressure. Hudson De Grugy will sit prominent while the hold-up horses Dare To Shout, Erne River and Wolfburg settle at the back. This creates a tactical race where the pace will be steady but fair rather than truly testing. The lack of pace pressure early on favours horses that can finish strongly from mid-pack or off the pace, giving hold-up performers and prominent racers with a turn of foot the clearest advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and no one puts serious pressure on Cadell until late
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows Dare To Shout and Erne River to conserve energy before unleashing late kicks. Their superior class tells when the race becomes a sprint from the last fence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front rank dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy or Hudson De Grugy apply sustained pressure from halfway, creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the back markers from closing effectively. Red Happy's three consecutive wins show he thrives when allowed to dictate from a forward position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cadell wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If no one challenges Cadell's lead and he maintains his rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: His front-running style proves perfectly suited to the lack of pace pressure, allowing him to control the race completely. Recent placed efforts suggest he's ready to return to winning form when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Cadell goes too slow and the race becomes a messy sprint with multiple challengers converging
scenarios.body: The lack of a true gallop turns this into a lottery where any horse can win from any position. Hudson De Grugy's recent inconsistency becomes less relevant in a scrambled finish.

watchPoints.text: Cadell's 5lb claiming jockey Jack Power could make crucial tactical errors when the race pressure intensifies
Red Happy's 393-day absence means his fitness levels are completely untested despite his hat-trick form
Walk On Quest and Cadell from the same stable could work together early to control the race tempo
Erne River's jumping under pressure needs monitoring as his recent efforts show inconsistent fence technique
Hudson De Grugy's prominent style could see him caught between paces if the tempo becomes stop-start

races.paceDynamic: Gozo is the only confirmed front runner and will set a manageable pace from flag to finish without early pressure. The prominent runners Parisian Fashion and Gonnino will track just behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Highly Recommended, The Best Way, Struth, and Alvesta will be content to settle towards the rear. With minimal pace pressure early, this creates a tactical affair that builds from halfway, allowing the strong finishers time to organize their challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Gozo sets an uncontested lead allowing the pace to build gradually
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from the back. Class horses like Highly Recommended and The Best Way can time their runs perfectly in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Fashion and Gonnino track Gozo closely and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The prominent pair benefits from their forward positions while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gozo Stays On Gamely
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains very steady and no serious challenge materializes until late
scenarios.body: The leader gets an armchair ride and has enough left to repel late challenges. His fitness edge from recent runs helps him maintain his advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos Ensues
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to challenge Gozo simultaneously from halfway creating a messy pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from three out with no clear tactical advantage. Stamina becomes secondary to turn of foot in a bunched finish.

races.paceDynamic: Hunters Spring will dictate from the front with little early pressure, as most of this field are hold-up horses by nature. Fine Point and Glenridding may track close but both can settle, leaving Hunters Spring to cruise through moderate fractions. The pace will build gradually through the race as the large hold-up contingent begins to close, but the early leader should face no serious challenge until late. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hunters Spring gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The front-runner faces no early pressure and can dictate ideal fractions before asserting late. Prominent trackers get first run while hold-up horses struggle for room in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace builds steadily and those tracking close get first run
scenarios.body: Hunters Spring sets it up but gets passed by horses with better finishing kicks positioned just behind. The moderate early pace allows tactical runners to pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with a crawling pace, suiting those who can produce their best from off the pace. Patient jockeys get rewarded for waiting.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Fine Point or Glenridding challenge Hunters Spring early
scenarios.body: Early pressure creates a strong pace that sets up the race for late closers. The prominent runners compromise each other's chances.

scenarios.title: Early Pressure Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Flying Skipper or another runner presses The Back Braes early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly and becomes a true test where stamina trumps speed, suiting horses with proven staying power over the trip. The genuine gallop exposes those lacking stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Back Braes gets easy lead and kicks clear turning home
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and builds an unassailable advantage before the hold-up horses can respond effectively. Clean jumping and tactical speed prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: The Back Braes setting too slow a gallop early - if he's not pressed the race becomes a lottery
Boley Bob's jumping on debut over fences - lightly raced horses can be erratic at obstacles
Bentley Road's fitness after 735 days off - even point-to-point form may not translate without racing sharpness
Early positioning of the unknown running styles - Flying Skipper and Phantoms Cave could disrupt expected pace
Ground conditions staying consistent - any deterioration would favour the hold-up horses even more

races.name: Racing TV Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Midday Rendezvous
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off a winning effort 37 days ago with solid recent form and proven on this going

runners_data.name: Cape Warrior
runners_data.note: Four-year-old prominent type with good recent second and proven form on similar good going conditions

runners_data.name: Dilrisk
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate the pace but comes here off a disappointing fourth last time out

runners_data.name: Yorgunnarock
runners_data.note: Completely unknown quantity with no recent form or ratings, making assessment impossible but potentially dangerous

runners_data.name: Teescomponents Gal
runners_data.note: Another lightly-raced unknown with no form guide, representing the biggest question mark in the field

runners_data.name: Eagle Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs things to fall right from the back but showed poor recent form and carries headgear

races.paceDynamic: Dilrisk shapes this as the sole natural front-runner in a small field, likely to dictate terms from the start without early pressure. The prominent trio of Midday Rendezvous, Cape Warrior, and potentially one of the lightly-raced unknowns will settle just behind, while Eagle Warrior tracks from the rear as a hold-up performer. With Dilrisk able to control fractions unchallenged early, this creates a tactical race where those able to travel strongly and quicken late hold the advantage. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can benefit from Dilrisk's pace-making.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front-Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dilrisk maintains a steady gallop and stays strong to the line
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader kicks clear turning for home and the chasers cannot reel him back in time. This rewards Dilrisk's stamina and tactical position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuine and Dilrisk weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The horses tracking the leader get first run and superior finishing speed tells over the tiring pace-setter. Form horses with proven ability capitalize on perfect positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady throughout and Eagle Warrior gets a clear run
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Eagle Warrior's late kick and Derek Fox's partner's tactical ride from the back pays dividends. Sandy Thomson's charge benefits from the strongest finishing effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If either Yorgunnarock or Teescomponents Gal shows unexposed ability
scenarios.body: One of the lightly-raced horses produces a performance well above their exposed form to spring a surprise. Their lack of public form makes them dangerous at big odds.

watchPoints.text: Dilrisk could steal this if allowed easy fractions up front with no early pressure in this small field
Watch the market moves on Yorgunnarock and Teescomponents Gal as any strong support would signal hidden ability
Eagle Warrior needs a clear passage from the rear and may struggle if the pace becomes pedestrian
Cape Warrior's inexperienced 5lb claimer Joshua Thompson could make tactical errors in a race requiring patience
Ground conditions remain consistently good across all distances which should suit the proven form horses
